text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOOOAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Alright, no matter how much I run on the turf—
it doesn't bother me at all anymore!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you, I've gotten completely used to it!
Thank you, Trainer!
choice_data_list: Yeah, taking our time was definitely the right call!
Yeah, taking our time was the right call!

text_block_list.text:
In the first place, before Biko Pegasus signed an exclusive Trainer contract with me,
she had primarily run on dirt tracks, but...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
...I really get to run on turf...!!
Thank you, Trainer!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"I'm super happy!! I mean, I—
I came to Tracen Academy because I admired
Carrotman running on the turf!!"

Ever since teaming up with me, she started running on turf too.
Now that she could handle the physical toll of turf without issue—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
A full-scale start! Then does that mean I can run
in whatever race I want, however I want now?!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: The time has finally come to take on those monsters in the Classic tier!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
All right, let's duel!
Come out, Palpitation Monster Out-of-Breather!
Monsters... not quite, but there were plenty of Umamusume in my generation who were as strong as monsters.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Come on, Brian! Face me!
One-on-one!

Hishi Amazon. The one-on-one Umamusume who faces
any powerful rival head-on in a fair fight.

"And when talking about our generation,
there is one existence you simply cannot overlook—"

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Come, Ama-san.
Enough talk. Let's begin.

Narita Brian. A lone wolf boasting overwhelming strength,
considered an absolute certainty for the Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Brian & Hishi Ama
text_block_list.text:
Haaaah...!
Take thiiiissss!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Oooh, what is this running...!
It's completely different from when I saw it before...!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Brian-san in particular has gotten insanely strong!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: A true demon lord... the final boss... The way I am now, even piloting the 20-piece combining DX robot, Carrot King, I might not stand a chance.
choice_data_list: Well, I won't be racing Brian anyway.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Not entering? Ah, that makes sense.
Brian-san is obviously going for the Triple Crown route, after all.

Biko Pegasus runs the sprint route.
On the other hand, Narita Brian...

The Classic Triple Crown. Running the three premier races of
the Satsuki Sho, the Nippon Derby, and the Kikuka Sho.
There's virtually no chance we'll clash.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Then there's nothing to be scared of—
choice_data_list: However, the big boss is someone else.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Nothing in particular?
This autumn, Biko Pegasus will be mixing it up with Senior Class Umamusume to compete in the sprint division.
The absolute champion currently reigning over the sprint division. Yes, that is—

Hahahaha! Did somebody call for me!?
Because here I am.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Huh, you didn't call for me? Well, I'd come even without an invitation.
After all—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Because I'm the Class Rep!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Oh, Bakushin O-senpai!

Sakura Bakushin O.
The unstoppable Umamusume who boasts absolute supremacy
in sprints, especially at 1200 meters.
She is without question one of the Umamusume that Biko Pegasus must be most mindful of this year.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Biko-san, could it be that you actually
want to do your best as a sprinter!?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
...! I want to do my best!
Of course I want to give it my all!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I want to get stronger.
Strong enough to compete with Bakushin O-senpai.
And then, someday—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see. You don't even need to say it, I understand.
In other words, this is the dream you envision.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I want to be class rep!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Huh... I don't... really think so, but...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Who wants to be class rep!?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: No, not really...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Indeed, indeed. If that is so, then become strong enough to put me in a fluster one day.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
This Class Rep will neither run nor hide!
I shall be waiting for our dream showdown of the summit class reps!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Bwahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Ah, hey!
Sakura Bakushin O left. It's truly amazing how she relentlessly forces her way through, whether in races or in everyday life.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I don't want to be a class rep, 
I want to be a hero! But...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"To do that, after all,
I've gotta get to the point where I can compete with Bakushin O-senpai!"
choice_data_list: Yeah, she's definitely one of the runners we should aim for.
Yeah, she's definitely someone to aspire to.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
All right, let's do it! Someday on a GⅠ stage,
with Bakushin O-senpai!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Where should we head for our next race to achieve that?
To compete against Sakura Bakushin O... I should definitely aim for a graded race of decent prestige or higher.

The NHK Mile Cup, a mile GI on the Classic Year sprint route.
Or, if we want to play it a bit safer...
choice_data_list: How about the GⅡ New Zealand Trophy?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
“New Zealand Trophy”!
That's a 1600m race, if I remember right.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I hear many Umamusume have gone on to win GⅠ races from there.
It's truly the gateway to becoming a hero...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's go with that! Teach me
some more new techniques, Trainer!
And so, with our sights set on conquering the big boss in the autumn, we decided to first take on the New Zealand Trophy.
